_readme: Provenance manifest for every fee/threshold fact centralized in lib/readiness/constants.ts and src/data/visa-fees.json / visa-details.json. Added per the fee/threshold truth-audit task. NOTE: data/knowledge/ (the official-source snapshot folder) is not present in this repo/environment (it is explicitly gitignored -- see .gitignore's 'chatbot training knowledge base ... never commit' entry) -- every 'source' field below that says 'needs human verification' means exactly that: the value could not be checked against an official document from inside this environment, and was left as whatever the codebase already had (Phase 1 audit already reconciled the code's own internal disagreements; this manifest does not change any value beyond that unless a source is cited). Do not treat a 'needs human verification' source as a confirmed fact.
